scope: Private native Linux full-collection policy experiment. Focused controls and diagnostic intervals; no original-runner campaign or complete-suite performance comparison.

plan.hypothesis: Every retired context requests kReduceMemoryFootprint full GC. That mode aggressively compacts, discards/free-pools memory and shrinks nursery/heap limits before a successor allocates again. Keep one explicit full collection and all access/worker/broker fences, but allow ordinary GC allocator retention. This differs from rejected collection batching and natural/no-explicit-GC candidates.
plan.change: Disabled-by-default FLASHWRIGHT_ORDINARY_RETIREMENT_GC=1 selects GCFlag::kNoFlags only at the existing PreciseCollectAllGarbage call. CheckMemoryPressure, collection count and callback flags remain unchanged. No other browser/Rust changes.
plan.knownSemanticDifference: Ordinary mode can sweep ArrayBuffer backing stores concurrently. Neither current mode nor new mode establishes synchronous completion of every weak callback/finalizer. Original realm/broker/worker retirement remains the isolation boundary.
gates: Build same candidate binary used off/on; verify actual branch in separate audit/trace controls, audit disabled for timings.

Before matched timing: original six controlled families at workers 1/4 including intentional failures; TodoMVC/SVGOMG at workers 1/4; eight graphics/video/trusted-input contexts and actual screenshot pixels per mode; old-world timer/fetch/finalizer controls and ArrayBuffer freshness; 48 fresh SVG contexts with <=24 documents at cycles 1/12/48 before final diagnostic GC, preserving the original long-suite document bound.

Advance if complete setup/assertion/navigation each improve >=10% at workers 1/4 in both orders OR an original application/worker cell improves >=20% in both orders; every other original application cell must avoid >5% regression. Matched charged memory and CPU must not exceed 1.10 of baseline in either pair.
Keep all observations, no selective reruns. Final nine-scenario majority/two-application/eight-pair goal unchanged. Any failed functional/memory gate blocks timing advancement.

plan.priorResults: Natural-GC-only candidate on Mac failed long-suite document memory gate. Two explicit cache-preserving collections selected memory-reduction as a refinement; no recorded kNoFlags full-collection comparison found. Linux every-fourth batching failed complete-time gate; do not repeat it.

decision.reason: Warm context-close median changed by about 0.4 ms in one diagnostic launch per mode. Insufficient evidence of a large complete-suite gain to prioritize over architectural work. No assertion that ordinary GC is slower or fails the predeclared suite threshold.

preservedFailedCapture.originalCleanup: natural drain; no cleanup signals or observed survivors
preservedFailedCapture.cause: Copied pressure fixture still waited for a native startup trace file, but this experiment uses native branch audit lines and did not enable startup tracing.
preservedFailedCapture.correction: Remove only the stale trace-publication wait, preserve all original pressure/isolation/input/close assertions and new buffer freshness assertion. Retain failed capture and original fixture.

limitations: One diagnostic launch per mode, audit enabled, extra repeated assertion; warm API medians are not complete-suite improvement.
Memory diagnostic uses a separate DevTools connection and remote debugging port in both modes. Counts at cycles 1/12/48 precede final diagnostic GC.
Ordinary full GC can sweep ArrayBuffer backing stores in the background. Neither mode establishes synchronous drainage of every finalizer.
Original-runner preflight and matched suite/resource timing were not run; the prospective performance gate was not evaluated.
Controls do not establish exhaustive isolation, hardware decoder first-use behavior, final resource acceptance or release readiness.
